connector.name: X402 Sms
connector.registryDescription: Pay-per-call MCP server. $0.03 USDC sends one transactional SMS to a US phone number via x402.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package x402-sms-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ultrastarz account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.description: Ethereum private key for the buyer wallet that pays the per-call USDC fee.
